description: Transfer Volume USD. Calls only GET /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/transfer-volume-usd and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching wallet transfer volume in USD. Get sent and received totals to analyze fund flow, activity levels and net movement.

ownerAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/transfer-volume-usd.

timeEnd.description: End of the time range (unix timestamp, seconds). Defaults to the current time.

timeStart.description: Start of the time range (unix timestamp, seconds). Defaults to 24 hours ago.

name: get-wallet-transfer-volume
title: Transfer Volume USD
